doc.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Future plans and goodbye
summary: Hopes for more concerts, teaching, orchestra work and a book, then thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: If we were to do an interview in ten years, what kind of things would you like me to be able to say that you’ve done?

Well we would have finished Caligula — The Musical, then it became a movie. No, I think I’d like to do more orchestra jobs and more things with my own group and I’m moving in this direction anyway now, but just playing more concerts, less of this constant life on the road you know, with this mystery band. So you know that’s what I think I © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-

would like to do. Maybe I’ll have a book out even, or something like that. More college things too, I love doing those. And I really like to teach people. So ten kids — still on my second wife because I don’t want — that’s enough now.
Ten kids. You’re going to have to play a lot of concerts.
Well wait a minute — I have to be home too a little bit, at least ten days I have to be home.
Right. Well it’s been a real pleasure for us.
And on behalf of Hamilton College I want to thank you for your time today, and I hope you have a great weekend.
Thank you. It was very nice talking to you.
